concerns.text: SC-002 requires the cleaned dataset to contain ≥ 300 records after exclusions. The ADReSS Challenge dataset (including ADReSSo) provides fewer than 400 total participants, and after applying the exclusion rules (< 50 words, missing labels) the attainable record count is likely well below 300. This quantitative success criterion was not part of the original research idea and may render the study infeasible, constituting an over‑reach / drift in scope.
